title: FLA import: decode CPicText color effects (Tint/Alpha/Brightness) — currently always null
description: RESOLVED — NOT APPLICABLE (was fixture-blocked; investigated to a definitive conclusion). Flash 8 text fields CANNOT carry an instance color effect (Tint/Brightness/Alpha) — it is an instance/bitmap-only property (the Properties panel has no color-effect control for static/dynamic/input text; text colour is per-character fillColor). Proof: the flacomdoc XFL->binary-FLA writer (byte-verified vs real Flash) has NO color-effect code in handleText, while handleSymbolInstance/handleBitmapInstance write the colorEffect block; and the no-effect fixture flash8-nested-textfields.fla (ts=0x0D) has no colorEffect pad in its CPicText body (task 1050 investigation). Therefore CPicText.colorEffect being always null is CORRECT, not a dropped value — the task premise ('a text field with a color effect') cannot occur. No fixture needs to be created and no decode is required. Code comment at flash8-binary.ts readCPicText updated to record this conclusion (replacing the speculative TODO(1050)). To tint text, put it in a symbol and tint the INSTANCE — that path is CPicSymbol.colorEffect, already decoded.
